rules.note: Scanned copy of your identification document (your passport).
Scanned copy of your previous education document (school certificate, bachelor's or master's diploma). Needs a notarised translation into Kazakh, Russian or English if it is in another language.
Transcript that comes with your previous education document. Needs a notarised translation into Kazakh, Russian or English if it is in another language.
Motivational essay in Kazakh, Russian or English.
One recommendation letter in Kazakh, Russian or English, from the school or university where you studied, or from your employer.
A medical certificate for studying abroad, plus a certificate showing you do not have HIV/AIDS, both issued by an official health authority in your country of residence.
Letter of invitation from a Kazakhstan university, if you have one.
PhD research proposal in Kazakh, Russian or English. Listed in the ministry's programme brochure (2020 edition).
International certificate confirming your knowledge of a foreign language. Listed in the ministry's programme brochure (2020 edition).
Not listed in the official requirements.
